description:
Salad turns downtime into downloads. Run Salad whenever you're away from the keys to score games, gift cards, subscriptions, DLC, and more at the Salad Storefront.


- Fixes an issue where machines with WSL installed outside the Microsoft Store were treated as missing WSL and couldn't run container workloads.
- Improves GPU detection, including support for newer GPUs.
- General maintenance and reliability improvements.
